free_tier.stated: USD 100 of free credit for 30 days, claimed in the browser with no card, then per-second list pricing; 20 sandboxes at once and sessions up to an hour on the Free plan.
free_tier.notes: Credit is a USD amount spent against compute meters; the trial is time-boxed to 30 days. A separate free, one-time validity report of 1,000 episodes is offered with no card.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a sandbox, not an object

retention.stated: A paused sandbox is kept for 30 days; waking it starts the 30 days again.

egress.terms: Included; registries and git hosts are not metered separately. The trial caps data out at 20 GB a month.
egress.free_allowance: included, with a 20 GB monthly data-out cap on the trial

interface_detail: CLI with a JSON mode, REST API, TypeScript and Python SDKs, and an MCP server; sandboxes are reached through exec, file commands and a shell.
tooling: The user installs the promigence CLI or an SDK; the hosted service supplies and bills the sandboxes.
chaining: A verified snapshot can be forked into many sandboxes under a spend cap, so eval, CI and coding-agent runs share one environment.

limits.value: USD 100 of free credit usable within 30 days; 20 concurrent sandboxes and sessions up to an hour on Free
20 GB data out per month on the trial

limits_note: A run is quoted before it starts and a hard spend cap pauses a sandbox that reaches it; paused time is not billed.
binding_note: The USD 100 credit with a 30-day expiry is the first allowance to run out; the 20 GB data-out cap is a separate, less likely binding limit.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up is invite-only: request access and Promigence emails an invite code with the credit; the console sign-up asks for that invite code. The credit is claimed in the browser with no card. The exact fields of the account form are unverified: the page shows only the invite-code step.

reliability_note: A sandbox that fails on the vendor side before hand-over is not billed; environment failures are reported apart from task failures. Health checks cannot be starved by workload.
confidence_note: Prices, free credit, egress and retention are quoted from the vendor's own reference and FAQ read on 2026-11-25; the account form behind the invite code was not seen.
